svg.title: micro-ROS node and transport topology between Teensy 4.0 and Raspberry Pi 5
svg.desc: Teensy 4.0 runs a micro-ROS client over USB serial 115200 to the micro-ROS Agent on the Raspberry Pi 5, which bridges it into a CycloneDDS ROS 2 graph. Teensy publishes odom/unfiltered, imu/data_raw, imu/mag and debug topics; it subscribes to cmd_vel and debug tuning topics. EKF plus Madgwick fuse raw IMU and odometry into filtered imu/data and odom for Nav2, which publishes cmd_vel back. The control loop runs only while the Agent is connected; on disconnect the firmware calls fullStop().

g.text: micro-ROS node & transport topology — Teensy 4.0 ⇄ Raspberry Pi 5
Fail-safe: the firmware actuates only while the transport is up; losing the Agent stops the motors at once.
